decisions.reason: The new business unit represents a high public commitment and substantial sunk investment in strategic offshore diversification, so management persists despite any disappointing results.
Although travel management saw pandemic-related setbacks, these are attributed to temporary external causes and the firm remains committed to the service it launched.
The online portal aligns with the firm's digitalization direction and has absorbed significant development costs, making withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.
The mobile app is part of the digital service portfolio and benefits from the same escalation dynamics, so it is retained.
